batch.description: Hajee Mohammad Danesh Science and Technology University (HSTU) admission test, academic session 2019-2020 — a single 100-question MCQ paper (Physics 25 + Chemistry 25 + Biology 25 + English 25), transcribed 2026-10-31 by direct visual reading of the HSTU 2019-20 chapter (printed book pp. 70-77) of Udvash's 'GST গুচ্ছ প্রশ্নব্যাংক', surviving as an 8-page TargetPDF/CamScanner scan. The source prints NO unit or set label anywhere on the 8 pages, so the paper is recorded with unit 'unassigned'; no unit was inferred from subject composition. Within each subject the book prints the questions grouped by syllabus tier (Short/Extra/Old Syllabus), each subject's numbers 1-25 occurring exactly once; the pack re-assembles each subject in printed-number order and each appearance carries the true compilation PDF page. Answers are the book's own inline keys — [Ans: x] margin tags and worked solutions headed 'সমাধান: (x)' — transcribed exactly as printed, including four printed multi-keys (Biology 17, Biology 20, English 22, English 23). Four questions (Physics 6; Chemistry 4, 6, 7) have their [Ans:] tags physically clipped off the scan's right edge and no printed solution; their answers are left unknown and were not guessed. All content and answers are single-source (Udvash) and unverified, pending unit identification and cross-source verification. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]
